items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: So Cootie and I joined Alonzo Ross' band. So Alonzo Ross was making a tour of Florida, and so when he came through Jacksonville, we joined his band

ctx.x: And after you played around there for a while, did you stay in Florida? Did you come back?

I'll tell you the story. After being in Pensacola, Florida, then we decided to make a tour of Florida. We went down to Jacksonville, Florida. So when we was in Jacksonville, Florida, I met a fellow there by the name of Eagle Eye Shields. So he liked what I was doing, so he asked me, he said, anytime you want to, anytime things get tough with you, you want to come down to Jacksonville. He had all to go down to Jacksonville anyway. He said, come on down, let me know, and we can get together. I'll put you in my…
I was wondering if you knew any people around there, like, just blues piano players around Savannah and Jacksonville, like Sugar Underwood? Sugar Underwood, yeah, I remember him.

items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1958-07-18
items.q: when I left and went to Florida, with Alonzo Ross' band.

ctx.x: When did you first start using arrangements in bands that you had to do in your reading with the band?
Well, when I left and went to Florida, with Alonzo Ross' band. They had arranger in the band, we used to have rehearsing, get the thing down, you know.
Had you ever read before that? No.
